root_cause_summary: The 40/48 vs 37/48 citation-accuracy gap is an evaluator/pipeline convention difference, not an algorithm defect: the frozen harness attached evidence-policy citations to refused answers (counting up to 5 refusals as accurate), while the official FastAPI path correctly emits zero citations on refusal. The two paths also use different evidence-policy candidate universes (frozen pool top-12 vs official retrieval) and different final-context rendering, so their raw answers are not directly comparable.
